stem.text: The graph shows the amount of antibody produced in response to an antigen.

stem.alt: Graph of concentration of antibody in the blood against time in days, from 0 to 40, with an arrow at day 0 labelled first exposure to an antigen.

stem.text: From the graph, which statement is correct?

A.text: It takes 25 days to achieve active immunity.

B.text: Memory cells for this antigen are present in the body within 20 days.

C.text: T-helper lymphocytes are activated on day 12.

D.text: The second exposure to the antigen occurred on day 25.
